definitions.explanation: A formal expression of gratitude, given as a speech at a ceremony or written at the front or end of a book or thesis.

examples.japanese: {謝辞|しゃじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{謝辞|しゃじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: At the graduation ceremony, a representative of the parents read words of thanks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くださった→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧{先生方|せんせいがた}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{謝辞|しゃじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: At the end of my thesis, I wrote acknowledgments to the professors who had supervised me.

notes:
A formal word.

- {謝辞|しゃじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to express thanks (in a speech)
- {謝辞|しゃじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧: to offer words of thanks
- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{謝辞|しゃじ}: acknowledgments in a thesis
